recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future Transport reconciliation should follow the later event-pattern decisions rather than treating FHIR-36275 as authority to restore superseded request-pattern elements.
issue_request: FHIR-36275 was a Published/Persuasive R5 OO change request asking to add or edit the missing Transport resources/elements listed from the Transport Resource Proposal spreadsheet. Jira records the resolution as "Will add in the spreadsheet" and its comments identify 9ca054b as the build application plus e63c6cb as cleanup for obsolete search terms.
initial_application: Commit 9ca054b3f79cbb741e241664b76d3a55baf40439 changed source/transport/structuredefinition-Transport.xml and added Transport terminology and examples for FHIR-36275. The later Jira cleanup comment references e63c6cb67b7e86025a272435f489648bebd69382 for removal of old search terms that caused errors.
additional_context: Transport remains active in source/fhir.ini and current source includes the event-oriented Transport resource, terminology, examples, and search parameters. Later applied Transport decisions intentionally changed the spreadsheet-era shape: FHIR-39512 made Transport an Event rather than a Request and removed intent/priority; FHIR-50911 removed request-only elements and renamed owner/requestedLocation/currentLocation/for to performer/to/from/subject; FHIR-50649 records that input/output value sets became unnecessary after those elements were removed.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Reintroducing all 2022 spreadsheet-era elements would conflict with later applied decisions, and the current build already contains the remaining Transport source artifacts introduced by or evolved from FHIR-36275.

related_jiras.note: Later final decision that Transport is an Event, not a Request, and request-specific elements such as intent and priority must be removed.
Later final decision removing remaining request-only Transport elements and renaming several elements to event-oriented names.
